_about: 执事堂's east wall (07-第七回: 「东墙上的牌子是乌木的…这些牌子不打架，是外门的杂役，谁揭都成」; Hanli 2026-10-27: 「目前就只能战斗刷经验吗? 好像没什么任务能做」 → new 杂役 posted daily, 「可以, 加吧」). `posts` of the `pool` go up each day (rules/rotation.mjs wallToday: by the day and the save's seed; never a tag two days running), all at once, taken at the wall (`at`) and handed in anywhere; one not done by day's end lapses with its day. Each tag asks one of a 观 place's boards (fixed or pooled: the tag stands it there whatever the day's set) or a small walk to fetch and deliver between 观 places. Pay: `work: labor` — the errand's share of the layer (balance.json play_pay.errand, rules/playpay.mjs errandGrant) and the labor table's 灵石, as 码柴 and 晒经. Only places on the 观's map; people as the book has them (周衡 keeps the account, 褚先生 teaches at the 讲堂).

who.zh: 执事堂 · 东墙的牌子
who.en: a tag on the stewards' hall's east wall

say.zh: 东墙一块乌木牌：「藏经阁 · 抄经。下三层一卷经叫虫蛀了，散成几片。先拼齐，才抄得下去。」杂役，外门可揭。
say.en: An ebony tag on the east wall: "Scripture hall · copying. A scroll on the lower floors has been eaten by worms and come apart in pieces. Fit it together first, or it cannot be copied." A chore, outer disciples may take it.

done.zh: 散页拼回一卷，字一个不缺。抄经的师兄接过去，压在镇纸底下。
done.en: The loose leaves are one scroll again, not a word missing. The brother copying it takes it and sets a paperweight on it.

say.zh: 东墙一块乌木牌：「三层靠窗那一架底下，压着一函旧档，周执事要用。架子挤，得一架一架挪开了抽出来。」杂役，外门可揭。
say.en: An ebony tag on the east wall: "Under the shelf by the window on the third floor lies a case of old records Steward Zhou needs. The shelves are packed: move them one at a time to get it out." A chore, outer disciples may take it.

done.zh: 那一函旧档抽出来了，一层灰。周衡掸了掸：「就是它。」
done.en: The case of records comes out under a coat of dust. Zhou Heng brushes it off: "That's the one."

say.zh: 东墙一块乌木牌：「新柴明日进门。旧柴挪进里头，压在底下那捆干松枝先得出来，伙房等着引火。」杂役，外门可揭。
say.en: An ebony tag on the east wall: "New wood comes in tomorrow. Shift the old wood to the back — the bundle of dry pine at the bottom has to come out first; the kitchen is waiting on it for kindling." A chore, outer disciples may take it.

done.zh: 那捆松枝拖出来了，旧柴码进了里头。门口空出一块地，等新柴。
done.en: The pine bundle is out and the old wood stacked at the back. A space stands clear by the door for the new.

say.zh: 东墙一块乌木牌：「柴房门上的旧门神叫雨泡烂了，一揭碎成几块。拼起来，好照着样子描一张新的。」杂役，外门可揭。
say.en: An ebony tag on the east wall: "The old door god on the woodshed door has rotted in the rain and broke in pieces when it came off. Fit it together, so a new one can be traced from it." A chore, outer disciples may take it.

done.zh: 门神拼回来了，一边胡子缺了半截。照样描的那张贴上门，倒也威风。
done.en: The door god is whole again, half of one whisker gone. The new one traced from it goes up on the door, fierce enough.

say.zh: 东墙一块乌木牌：「灶头那张灶王像叫烟熏潮了，一揭就碎。拼齐了，好照着请一张新的。」杂役，外门可揭。
say.en: An ebony tag on the east wall: "The stove god's picture over the stove has gone damp with smoke and fell apart when it came down. Fit it together so a new one can be had to match." A chore, outer disciples may take it.

done.zh: 灶王爷拼回来了，一脸油烟，照旧笑眯眯的。
done.en: The stove god is back together, his face black with smoke, smiling as ever.

say.zh: 东墙一块乌木牌：「伙房 · 帮厨。讲堂午后要茶水，到伙房提一壶，送去讲堂。」杂役，外门可揭。
say.en: An ebony tag on the east wall: "Kitchen · helping out. The lecture hall wants tea in the afternoon: fetch a pot from the kitchen and take it there." A chore, outer disciples may take it.

done.zh: 茶送到时褚先生正讲到一半，抬眼看了看你，接着讲。
done.en: When the tea arrives Master Chu is halfway through a lesson. He glances up at you and goes on.

say.zh: 东墙一块乌木牌，抄着一局残棋，底下一行白粉小字：「红先胜。解者记功。」
say.en: An ebony tag on the east wall with an endgame chalked on it, and under it in small white letters: "Red to move and win. Credit to whoever solves it."

done.zh: 你把着法写在牌子背面。周衡翻过来看了看，在账上记了一笔：「记功。」
done.en: You write the moves on the back of the tag. Zhou Heng turns it over, looks, and makes an entry: "Credited."

title.en: The outer court · Keeping a patient company

say.zh: 东墙一块乌木牌：「通铺东头的师兄崴了脚，躺了三天，闷得慌。去陪他下一盘五子。」杂役，外门可揭。
say.en: An ebony tag on the east wall: "The brother at the east end of the sleeping hall turned his ankle and has been lying there three days, bored stiff. Go and play him a game of five in a row." A chore, outer disciples may take it.

done.zh: 他输了也不恼，把棋子一颗一颗拣回罐里：「明天再来。」
done.en: He loses and doesn't mind, picking the stones back into the pot one by one: "Come again tomorrow."

say.zh: 东墙一块乌木牌：「讲堂 · 值日。散了课，后排矮桌上还摆着一盘没下完的五子。下完了，才好收拾。」杂役，外门可揭。
say.en: An ebony tag on the east wall: "Lecture hall · duty. After class there's an unfinished game of five in a row on a back desk. Finish it, then it can be cleared." A chore, outer disciples may take it.

done.zh: 一局下完，棋子收回罐里，矮桌也擦干净了。
done.en: The game is played out, the stones back in their pots, the desk wiped clean.

say.zh: 东墙一块乌木牌：「山下捎来的家信压在山门的石屋里。取了，送回外门通铺。」杂役，外门可揭。
say.en: An ebony tag on the east wall: "Letters from home sent up the mountain are waiting in the stone hut at the gate. Fetch them and take them to the outer court's sleeping hall." A chore, outer disciples may take it.

done.zh: 信一封一封搁到各人铺头。好几个师兄当场就拆了。
done.en: The letters go one by one onto each bed. Several brothers tear theirs open on the spot.

say.zh: 东墙一块乌木牌：「正殿的长明灯油浅了。到伙房灌一壶灯油，送去正殿。」杂役，外门可揭。
say.en: An ebony tag on the east wall: "The ever-burning lamp in the main hall is running low. Fill a pot with lamp oil at the kitchen and take it there." A chore, outer disciples may take it.

done.zh: 灯油添满，火苗稳了。正殿里很静，只有你倒油的声音。
done.en: The lamp is full and the flame steadies. The main hall is very quiet but for the oil you pour.

say.zh: 东墙一块乌木牌：「柴房里修好的两把锄头，送去药园。」杂役，外门可揭。
say.en: An ebony tag on the east wall: "Two hoes mended in the woodshed — take them to the herb garden." A chore, outer disciples may take it.

done.zh: 药园的人接过锄头，掂了掂，没说话，扛着下地了。
done.en: The garden hand takes the hoes, weighs them, says nothing, and shoulders them off to the beds.
